name: Second Directional Derivative for Boundary Disambiguation
definition: A method to disambiguate complex material boundaries (e.g., background-dentin vs. pulp-dentin) that overlap in 2D data-value/gradient-magnitude histograms by using a second derivative measure along the gradient direction.
summary: Second Directional Derivative for Boundary Disambiguation resolves overlapping material boundaries in volume rendering by computing the second derivative along the gradient direction, distinguishing itself through this specific Hessian-based mathematical mechanism.
